premise.claim: Several sites iterate over Go maps without key sorting when building NodeSelectorTerms or MatchExpressions (issue #6220): nodeaffinitywithcache getTieredLocalityPreferredSchedulingTerms/getTieredLocalityNodeSelectorTerms, requirenodewithfuse getRequiredSchedulingTerm, utils/dataset/volume CreatePersistentVolumeForRuntime, ddc/efc createPersistentVolumeForRuntime. For pods bound to multiple datasets/runtimes (or multi-label fuse selectors) this yields non-deterministic term/expression order in mutated pod specs and PV node affinity.
premise.patchedComponent: same four sites + pkg/utils/affinity.go (new helper) + pkg/utils/kubeclient/pod.go (refactor)
premise.evidence: On base a01c038b the four contract tests fail with observed unsorted orders (e.g. [zone arch region] vs want [arch region zone]; preferred term[0]=runtime-b before runtime-a); on head c9dfc9f4 all four pass. See results/base-unit.txt and results/head-unit.txt.
